MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The small magnets fit my recent interest in magnetic hooks because they could help with small organizing projects, though I would still need to check their strength and size.",
    "The metric screws connect with my recent fastener purchases, but that makes them relevant to consider rather than something I would buy without a specific need."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The caster sets assume I want to make furniture or a workbench mobile; buying a hand truck does not establish that need or tell me whether those mounts would fit.",
    "Masks, bulk gloves and a COVID test do not support the organizing and fastening tasks reflected in my recent purchases.",
    "The rotary burrs require a carving or grinding project I have not shown interest in, and the outdoor tape would only appeal if I had a repair to make."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My hand truck purchase seems to have been taken as a broad interest in wheels and moving equipment.",
    "My hardware purchases seem to have been stretched into interest in almost any workshop or supply item, even when it serves a different task."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My two recent magnetic-hook purchases make magnetic organizing supplies a more natural next choice than unrelated workshop equipment.",
    "Buying fastener assortments does not mean I need a hundred identical screws; exact dimensions, head style and a current project determine whether I would act.",
    "I rarely buy without a clear use, so general usefulness alone is not enough to make me choose an item now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in magnets and fasteners but extended it too broadly into equipment and supplies for tasks I do not currently have."
}
